_comment: Example Claude Code settings with the budget and cache hooks from claude-cost-optimizer.
Merge the hooks block into ~/.claude/settings.json (global) or .claude/settings.json (project).
Update the paths below to point to wherever you cloned claude-cost-optimizer. Keep each script in hooks/ next to tools/claude-rate/rate.py, or set CLAUDE_RATE_PY to rate.py's full path.

PreModelSwitch needs Claude Code v2.1.251 or later. The schemastore schema declared above does not list PreModelSwitch yet (read 2026-11-03), so an editor that validates against it flags that one key; Claude Code accepts it. Drop the PreModelSwitch block if your editor setup rejects the file.

SessionEnd has "timeout": 10 because SessionEnd hooks share a 1.5-second budget by default, and pricing a long session's transcript from scratch can take longer (it reuses budget-tracker's state when there is one).
Do not give the PreModelSwitch entry a short timeout: a PreModelSwitch hook that reaches its timeout blocks the switch. cache-guard.sh stops its own work after 3 seconds.
_opt_in_hooks is not read by Claude Code. Move its SessionStart entry into hooks to load the notes /handoff (templates/commands/handoff.md) writes, once, after /clear.

Move its PostToolUse entry into hooks to trim the output of green build, install and test runs before Claude reads it (output-trim.sh, Claude Code 2.1.121 or later). Keep output_trim.py in the same folder; failed runs are never trimmed.
Environment variables (optional; set them in your shell or in an env block):
BUDGET_TOOL_LIMIT        - max tool calls before warning (default: 50)
BUDGET_WARN_AT           - warn at this percentage of the limit (default: 80)
BUDGET_LOG_DIR           - counter, marker, state and log files (default: /tmp/claude-budget; %TEMP%\claude-budget on Windows)
BUDGET_SESSION_USD_WARN  - one warning when session spend passes this many dollars
BUDGET_SESSION_USD       - session cap: warn at 70/80/90%, ask at 100% and every +25% after
BUDGET_DAY_USD           - the same ladder for today's spend across sessions
BUDGET_TURN_USD          - the same ladder for one prompt's spend
BUDGET_HARD_DENY         - 1 = deny tool calls once a cap is 120% spent
CLAUDE_RATE_PY           - full path to tools/claude-rate/rate.py
CACHE_GUARD_MIN_TOKENS   - stale-resume warnings start at this context size (default: 50000)
HANDOFF_MAX_AGE_HOURS    - the loader ignores notes older than this (default: 24)
CLAUDE_TRIM_OFF          - 1 = output-trim.sh leaves every output unchanged (kill switch)
CLAUDE_TRIM_MIN_CHARS    - output-trim.sh leaves output shorter than this alone (default: 2000)
Every dollar figure is a list-price estimate; on a Pro, Max or Ultra plan it is API-equivalent value, not your bill.
